what_happened.line: Library trustees voted unanimously by roll call to make the library fine free as of July 1, 2021, after a long discussion of fine revenue.
Fine revenue has trended down over the years and was very low this year, the board heard during the fine-free discussion.
Fines go into a revolving fund outside the appropriated budget, which pays for magazines and databases; other money covered those costs this year.
A voluntary donation jar for late returns was deferred and will be an agenda item at the next meeting.
The board kept its officers and subcommittees unanimously, adding a member to the budget subcommittee.

why_it_matters: Late fees on library materials end July 1, 2021, so residents will no longer be charged for overdue items.

Fines went to a revolving fund outside the town budget, so the vote touches how magazines and databases are paid for; the board should say what covers them once fines stop, and a donation jar may be proposed as one source.
watch_next: The next meeting, expected in person with a Zoom option, will take up the voluntary donation jar for late returns.
